_comment: Template for the user-scope MCP servers (normally stored in ~/.claude.json under the top-level "mcpServers" key). SECRETS HAVE BEEN REMOVED — see README + .env.example. Paths marked LOCAL-TOOL point at machine-specific binaries you must install/adjust. setup.sh registers these with `claude mcp add-json`.

lean-ctx._note: LOCAL-TOOL. Requires the lean-ctx binary (see the `lean-ctx` skill / https://leanctx.ai). Adjust 'command' to wherever it installs on your machine; `which lean-ctx` to find it.

magic._note: 21st.dev Magic. NEEDS YOUR OWN API KEY — get one at https://21st.dev and put it in .env as MAGIC_API_KEY (setup.sh substitutes it).

waveforge._note: LOCAL-TOOL. Waveforge sound engine running from a local Python venv. Clone/build waveforge, create its venv, then point 'command' at that venv's python. Remove this entry if you don't use Waveforge.
